problem_resolution.justification: The system correctly identified the root cause as a security group misconfiguration blocking database access and applied the correct fix by updating the security group. The problem was resolved as metrics returned to baseline, and wasteful scaling was avoided.

multi_agent_coordination.justification: The RCA agent effectively coordinated with both the performance and security agents, as evidenced by the calls to ask_performance_agent and ask_security_agent. The RCA agent synthesized findings from both agents to identify the root cause.

diagnostic_workflow.justification: All five phases of the diagnostic workflow were completed: symptom analysis, change investigation, hypothesis testing, root cause confirmation, and remediation.

memory_usage.justification: The system retrieved necessary context including baseline metrics, recent changes, network topology, and troubleshooting policies, as evidenced by the memory queries and results.

remediation_correctness.justification: The correct remediation was applied by updating the security group, and no wasteful scaling was performed.

strengths: Correctly identified and resolved the root cause.
Complete adherence to the diagnostic workflow.
